value.rationale: Motivated by the established difference between reachable subset-construction size and actual minimal language complexity, and by recent hardness of predicting that difference. This full, natural three-state/two-letter/singleton-endpoint population classification gives every joint frequency and a sharp trim overhead of five with exact prevalence, plus the independent full-subset-reachability boundary. It does not claim an asymptotic advance.
